claims.claim_text: UA (1 µM) for 24 h significantly increased expression of genes for mitochondrial biogenesis and OXPHOS
C-peptide-SLN-PTX markedly improved cytotoxicity against 4T1 carcinoma cells, with an IC50 of 1.2 µg/mL, compared to 3.4 µg/mL for SLN-PTX and 8.9 µg/mL for free PTX
encapsulation efficiency over 90%, with favorable release profiles for acidic tumor environments
In vivo studies in 4T1 tumor-bearing mice showed an 82% tumor volume reduction and prevented pulmonary metastasis
≈50% decrease in mitochondrial function, affecting all substrates.
